description: This source file defines the EndpointParameterMiddleware class used within the AWS SDK for PHP. The class manages updating the request host based on endpoint parameters modeled through traits, integrating into middleware handling for AWS service commands.

classes.name: Aws\EndpointParameterMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for updating request host based on endpoint parameters modeled with traits. It wraps command execution to modify the request URI accordingly.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function that returns an instance of EndpointParameterMiddleware configured with a given Service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler and the service definition.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, modifying the request URI's host based on endpoint parameters if necessary, and then proceeds with the next handler.
